f3_program: observe(at("steve.earnings.target", "four_days"), 100, "dollar", source("make a total of $100 within four days"))
observe(at("berry_picking_job.pay_rate", "current"), 2, "dollar_per_pound", source("The job paid $2 for every pound of lingonberries picked"))

rate_relation(at("steve.earnings.target", "four_days"), at("berry_picking_job.pay_rate", "current"), at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), source("The job paid $2 for every pound of lingonberries picked"))
produce("monday_harvest", "steve", at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), 8, source("On Monday he picked 8 pounds"))

produce("tuesday_harvest", "steve", at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), scale(event_field("monday_harvest", "quantity"), 3), source("Tuesday’s harvest was triple what he had picked the previous day"))
produce("thursday_harvest", "steve", at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), "steve.lingonberries.thursday_harvest.weight", source("pick on Thursday"))
query("value", event_field("thursday_harvest", "quantity"))
assumptions: The four-day interval is Monday through Thursday.
Resting on Wednesday means no lingonberries were picked that day.
The $100 target is gross job earnings at the stated dollar-per-pound rate.

f3_program: collection("anna.garden.lettuce_plants", "lettuce_plant", "garden", source("Anna wants to grow some lettuce in the garden"))
observe(at("anna.large_salads.minimum_required.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("at least 12 large salads"))
produce("grow_lettuce", "anna", at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.count", "current"), "anna.garden.lettuce_plants.grown.count", source("grow some lettuce in the garden"))

remove("lettuce_loss", "insects_and_rabbits", at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.count", "current"), fraction(event_field("grow_lettuce", "quantity"), 1, 2), source("half of the lettuce will be lost to insects and rabbits"))
observe(at("lettuce_plant.large_salad_yield", "current"), 3, "large_salad_per_lettuce_plant", source("Each lettuce plant is estimated to provide 3 large salads"))

rate_relation(at("anna.large_salads.minimum_required.count", "current"), at("lettuce_plant.large_salad_yield", "current"), at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.count", "current"), source("Each lettuce plant is estimated to provide 3 large salads"))
query("value", event_field("grow_lettuce", "quantity"))
assumptions: The loss fraction applies to the lettuce plants grown, and the requested count is the minimum whole-number plant count that meets the salad target.

f3_program: collection("ethan.candles", "candle", "ethan", source("Ethan makes beeswax candles"))
collection("ethan.candles.ingredient_total_weights", "ingredient_weight", "ethan.candles", source("8 ounces of beeswax and 1 ounce of coconut oil"))
observe(at("ethan.candles.beeswax.rate", "current"), 8, "ounce_per_candle", source("For each candle, he uses 8 ounces of beeswax"))
observe(at("ethan.candles.coconut_oil.rate", "current"), 1, "ounce_per_candle", source("1 ounce of coconut oil"))
produce("candle_making", "ethan", at("ethan.candles.count", "current"), "ethan.candles.made.count", source("he makes three less than 10 candles"))
offset(event_field("candle_making", "quantity"), 10, -3, "count", source("three less than 10 candles"))

rate_relation(at("ethan.candles.beeswax.total_weight", "current"), at("ethan.candles.beeswax.rate", "current"), event_field("candle_making", "quantity"), source("For each candle, he uses 8 ounces of beeswax"))

rate_relation(at("ethan.candles.coconut_oil.total_weight", "current"), at("ethan.candles.coconut_oil.rate", "current"), event_field("candle_making", "quantity"), source("For each candle, he uses 8 ounces of beeswax and 1 ounce of coconut oil"))
member("ethan.candles.ingredient_total_weights", "ethan.candles.beeswax.total_weight", source("8 ounces of beeswax"))
member("ethan.candles.ingredient_total_weights", "ethan.candles.coconut_oil.total_weight", source("1 ounce of coconut oil"))
query("sum", "ethan.candles.ingredient_total_weights", "current")
assumptions: The candles' combined weight is the sum of the beeswax and coconut oil used, with no other mass or material loss.

f3_program: observe(at("group.shared_money.amount", "initial"), 50, "dollar", source("Tony, Moses and Esther are to share $50"))

sum_relation(at("group.shared_money.amount", "initial"), at("tony.money.share", "final"), at("moses.money.share", "final"), at("esther.money.share", "final"), source("Tony, Moses and Esther are to share $50"))
percent_of(at("moses.money.share", "final"), at("group.shared_money.amount", "initial"), 40, source("Moses will take 40% of the total amount"))
same(at("tony.money.share", "final"), at("esther.money.share", "final"), source("Tony and Esther will split the remainder equally among themselves"))
query("difference", at("esther.money.share", "final"), at("moses.money.share", "final"))
collection("grant.baby_teeth", "tooth", "grant", source("All 20 of Grant’s baby teeth"))
observe(at("grant.baby_teeth.fallen.count", "current"), 20, "count", source("All 20 of Grant’s baby teeth have fallen out"))
observe(at("grant.baby_teeth.dropped.count", "current"), 1, "count", source("one that he dropped on the way home from school"))

same(at("grant.baby_teeth.swallowed.count", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.dropped.count", "current"), source("one that he dropped on the way home from school and another he swallowed accidentally"))

sum_relation(at("grant.baby_teeth.fallen.count", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.placed_under_pillow.count", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.dropped.count", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.swallowed.count", "current"), source("Every time he lost a tooth, he put it under his pillow for the tooth fairy, except for one that he dropped on the way home from school and another he swallowed accidentally"))
offset(at("grant.baby_teeth.placed_under_pillow_after_first.count", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.placed_under_pillow.count", "current"), -1, "count", source("per tooth after his first tooth"))
add("first_tooth_payment", "tooth_fairy", at("grant.tooth_fairy.money_received", "current"), 20, source("The tooth fairy left Grant $20 when he lost his first tooth"))
add("later_tooth_payments", "tooth_fairy", at("grant.tooth_fairy.money_received", "current"), "grant.tooth_fairy.money_received.after_first", source("money exchanged for each tooth thereafter"))
observe(at("grant.tooth_fairy.money_received", "now"), 54, "dollar", source("a total of $54 from the tooth fairy"))

rate_relation(event_field("later_tooth_payments", "quantity"), at("grant.tooth_fairy.payment_per_tooth_after_first", "current"), at("grant.baby_teeth.placed_under_pillow_after_first.count", "current"), source("assuming equal money exchanged for each tooth thereafter"))
query("value", at("grant.tooth_fairy.payment_per_tooth_after_first", "current"))
assumptions: Tooth-fairy payments correspond only to teeth placed under the pillow, and the first tooth was one of those teeth.
The stated total consists of the first-tooth payment plus the equal payments thereafter.
